tagline: 理光便携相机，1995 年发布
description: 理光于1995年推出的便携相机。配备38mm f/4.5 - 110mm f/9.1, 2.9X zoom, 7 elements in 6 groups。快门速度1 sec. (Super-night mode), 1/2 sec. - 1/400 sec. (Normal mode)。感光度ISO 50 - 3200 (DX-code system)。7-point multi autofocus with single AF facility, 1027 focusing steps, Passive Autofocus with auxiliary AF light。

specs.镜头: 38mm f/4.5 - 110mm f/9.1, 2.9X zoom, 7 elements in 6 groups
specs.对焦: 7-point multi autofocus with single AF facility, 1027 focusing steps, Passive Autofocus with auxiliary AF light
specs.闪光灯: Auto/ On/ Off, Slow synchro, Red-eye reduction, Red-eye reduction slow synchro
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh Myport 310SF is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1995.
